title: Text
description: Compare two strings and return the intersection or difference, use overlap to find the matching characters between the two strings, or use similarity to get a numeric similarity score.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The columns to compare. First column is the base column.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: The column to output the results to. Must be a list of two column names [mask_column, ratio_column] when method is overlap and include_ratio is true; otherwise a single column name.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: The type of comparison to perform (difference, intersection, overlap, similarity).

parameters.name: char
parameters.description: Character to split strings on for difference and intersection. Defaults to a space.

parameters.name: non_match_char
parameters.description: Character to use for non-matching characters when using overlap.

parameters.name: include_ratio
parameters.description: Include the ratio of matching characters when using overlap.

parameters.name: decimal_places
parameters.description: Number of decimal places to round the overlap ratio to.

parameters.name: exact_match
parameters.description: Value to use for exact matches when using overlap.

parameters.name: empty_a
parameters.description: Value to use when input A is empty when using overlap.

parameters.name: empty_b
parameters.description: Value to use when input B is empty when using overlap.

parameters.name: all_empty
parameters.description: Value to use when both inputs are empty when using overlap.

parameters.name: case_sensitive
parameters.description: Whether the comparison is case sensitive. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Metric value accepted by the runtime.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Compare two strings and return the intersection or difference, or use overlap to find the matching characters between the two strings. ## Migrated examples #### Comparing the difference between two columns of text ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - compare.text: input: - col1 - col2 output: Difference method: difference ```
##### Input Sample | Col1 | Col2 | | --- | --- | | Large Oak Wood White Marble Top Bookshelf | Large Pine Wood Black Marble Bottom Bookshelf | | Medium Oak Wood White Marble Top Coffee Table | Medium Maple Wood Orange Steel Top Coffee Table | | Small Oak Wood White Marble Top Console Table | Small Normal Wood Blue Plastic Top Console Table |
##### Output Sample | Difference | | --- | | Pine Black Bottom | | Maple Orange Steel | | Normal Blue Plastic |
#### Comparing the intersection of two columns of text ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - compare.text: input: - col1 - col2 output: Intersection method: intersection ```
##### Input Sample | Col1 | Col2 | | --- | --- | | Large Oak Wood White Marble Top Bookshelf | Large Pine Wood Black Marble Bottom Bookshelf | | Medium Oak Wood White Marble Top Coffee Table | Medium Maple Wood Orange Steel Top Coffee Table | | Small Oak Wood White Marble Top Console Table | Small Normal Wood Blue Plastic Top Console Table |
##### Output Sample | Intersection | | --- | | Large Wood Marble Bookshelf | | Medium Wood Top Coffee Table | | Small Wood Top Console Table |
#### Comparing the overlap of two columns of text ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - compare.text: input: - Part Code1 - Part Code2 output: Overlap method: overlap ```
##### Input Sample | Part Code1 | Part Code2 | | --- | --- | | SKF6202 | TMKN6202 | | X06-02-000 | X06-81-000 | | 7100E15-V-230/3 | 7100E15-V-120/1 |
##### Output Sample | Overlap | | --- | | ****6202 | | X06-**-000 | | 7100E15-V-\**0/\* |
